item.text: All 30 pages are fetched, with 20 duplicate listings discarded. One shipped order dated February 28 locally falls on March 1 in UTC, so it qualifies. I’m checking the saved data independently before finalizing the files.

item.command:
/bin/bash -lc "python3 - <<'PY'
import json
from pathlib import Path
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from decimal import Decimal, ROUND_HALF_UP
from collections import Counter
work = Path('/tmp/spring-reconciliation')
pages = json.loads((work/'pages.json').read_text())
customers = json.loads((work/'customers.json').read_text())
result_path = Path('/workspace/result.json')
result = json.loads(result_path.read_text())
assert set(result) == {'total_cents','order_count','duplicates_skipped','by_region'}
assert set(result['by_region']) == {'north','south','east','west'}
assert all(type(v) is int for k,v in result.items() if k "'!= '"'by_region')
assert all(type(v) is int for v in result['by_region'].values())
assert [p['page'] for p in pages] == list(range(1,31))
assert all(p['total_pages'] == 30 for p in pages)
assert all(p['next'] == (f'/orders?page={i+2}' if i < 29 else None) for i,p in enumerate(pages))
listings = [o for page in pages for o in page['items']]
unique = {o['id']:o for o in listings}
regions = Counter(dict.fromkeys(('north','south','east','west'),0))
count = 0
half_cent_orders = 0
for o in unique.values():
    utc = datetime.fromisoformat(o['placed_at'].replace('Z','+00:00')).astimezone(timezone.utc)
    if o['status'] == 'shipped' and '2025-03-01' <= utc.date().isoformat() <= '2025-05-31':
        c = customers[o['customer_id']]
        raw = Decimal(o['amount_cents']) * (Decimal(100) - Decimal(c['discount_pct'])) / Decimal(100)
        discounted = int(raw.quantize(Decimal(1),rounding=ROUND_HALF_UP))
        half_cent_orders += raw % 1 == Decimal('0.5')
        regions[c['region']] += discounted
        count += 1
expected = {'total_cents':sum(regions.values()), 'order_count':count,
            'duplicates_skipped':len(listings)-len(unique),'by_region':dict(regions)}
assert result == expected, (result,expected)
assert sum(result['by_region'].values()) == result['total_cents']
print(json.dumps(result,indent=2))
print(f'Independent verification passed; {len(listings)} listings, {len(unique)} distinct orders, {half_cent_orders} qualifying half-cent ties.')
PY"
